comment: Pin for the Minecraft 1.18.1 font pipeline (tools/fetch_mc_font.py).
This file holds URLs and hashes only. No Mojang asset is committed to
this repository: the textures are downloaded from Mojang's official
distribution servers at build time, verified against these hashes, and
kept out of Git until agent C's provenance/licence gate says otherwise.
Wurst 7.19 targets Minecraft 1.18.1, which is why this exact version.

versionManifest.comment: Not hash-pinned: Mojang appends new versions to it. The 1.18.1 entry inside it must match versionJson below.

resources.comment: Asset objects are content-addressed by their own sha1, which is the verification.

font.comment: default.json and the bitmap provider textures live inside client.jar; glyph_sizes.bin and the legacy unicode pages live in the asset objects. The tool reads whatever default.json really declares - the provider list is not assumed here, it is extracted from the verified jar.

fallback.name: monocraft-fallback
fallback.comment: Monocraft (OFL) is the committed fallback. It is a Minecraft-inspired vector font, not Mojang's bitmap font, and must never be labelled 'Minecraft exact'.
